decisions.reason: The view-color decision concerns drawing presentation, while this Requirement independently governs the drawing package and file formats; its existing same-message Event already captures the format request.
Changing the color treatment of drawing views does not alter dimension-annotation accuracy, and the unspecified minor notes do not entail a concrete annotation change.
The source Event changes the presentation of 3D views within drawings, not delivery of 3D CAD models; the separate format question does not change the existing IPT-preferred and STEP-minimum state.
Drawing view colors do not change the bushing location, retention, clearances, guidance arrangement, or retained holes.
Drawing view colors do not change the lug assembly geometry, fabrication sequence, angular spacing, or face-finishing requirements.
